items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: the other later guitar pickers that I met, uh, well, they, it's really good too, but they drank so much music and, uh, stopped playing the guitar and started talking and then they started back again. Such as Lee Jenkins and Robert Jenkins and, uh, Herman Johnson.

ctx.x: And dude Morgan, he was down by Scotland. He played guitar in the theater. And, uh, of course, the other later guitar pickers that I met, uh, well, they, it's really good too, but they drank so much music and, uh, stopped playing the guitar and started talking and then they started back again. Such as Lee Jenkins and Robert Jenkins and, uh, Herman Johnson. I guess you know Herman Johnson. Yeah, I bet.
